claims.text: US President Donald Trump wrote on social media that Canada wants the benefits of being a State without being one after trade talks collapsed.
The United States imposed 50% tariffs on $20 billion worth of Canadian goods, which came into force on Saturday.
Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney pledged to match US tariffs dollar for dollar starting September 8 on items including steel, dairy, appliances, and electronics.
Canadian Federation of Independent Business president Dan Kelly estimated that 40% of small Canadian exporters will be directly hit by the US tariffs.
Donald Trump refused to renew the USMCA trade pact this summer after Canada and Mexico formally requested a 16-year renewal.
US President Donald Trump stated on Fox News that Canadians were foolish to engage in a trade war with the US and think they will win.
The 50% US tariffs affect approximately $20 billion of Canadian imports, representing about 5% of total Canadian exports.
US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer stated on Saturday that there are no plans to resume trade talks with Canada.
Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney stated that US negotiators made threats against the French language, Quebec culture, and Canadian culture.

During a January visit to China, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney agreed to reduce tariffs on a capped number of Chinese electric vehicles in exchange for lowered Chinese duties on Canadian canola.
Canadian exports to the US totaled $409 billion last year, accounting for 73 percent of all Canadian exports.
Donald Trump initially announced 50% tariffs on July 20, citing Canadian bans on the sale of US alcohol in provincial stores.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy warned that holding elections during the war is a huge risk and would be a tsunami for the state that will split Ukraine.
Ukraine suspended national elections under martial law following Russia's full-scale invasion in 2022, and Volodymyr Zelenskyy's five-year presidential term formally expired in May 2024.
Ousted former Ukrainian defence minister Mykhailo Fedorov publicly called for Ukraine to organize fresh elections despite the ongoing war.
Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that Russia possesses a stockpile of between 600 and 630 high-speed ballistic missiles and seeks to produce over 100 a month.

Former Ukrainian Defence Minister Mykhailo Fedorov stated in a BBC interview that Volodymyr Zelenskyy should face questions regarding his awareness of potential inner-circle corruption following a money laundering investigation.
Ukraine's anti-corruption bureau uncovered a scheme misappropriating more than $3 million in Ukrainian currency to pay bail for a former energy minister accused of money laundering.
Germany agreed to supply Ukraine with about 600 PAC-2 and PAC-3 interceptors in 2027 and 2028.
Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated he believes Russia will try to conscript an additional 300,000 soldiers following its parliamentary elections in September.
Norway announced plans to give 85 billion Norwegian crowns ($9.2 billion) in financial support to Ukraine in the 2027 fiscal year.
Iran announced the discovery of more than 200 billion cubic metres of natural gas in Fars province, with over 160 billion cubic metres potentially recoverable.
Iranian Oil Minister Mohsen Paknejad stated that the new natural gas discovery in Fars province contains more than 7.5 trillion cubic feet of gas, with around 5.7 trillion cubic feet recoverable.
Attacks on Iranian energy infrastructure starting in late February reduced Iran's daily gas production capacity by around a quarter.
US President Donald Trump shared a graphic on Truth Social depicting the Strait of Hormuz as new US territory.
Iranian Supreme National Security Council secretary Mohsen Rezaei warned neighboring countries that Iran will consider them enemies if they join the US economic war.
Iranian Oil Minister Mohsen Paknejad described the newly discovered gas as sweet, indicating low levels of hydrogen sulphide that will lower development and operating costs.
Iran's pre-war natural gas production was estimated at approximately 650 million cubic metres per day.
